stat: Roughly 1 in 3 women (around 840 million globally) experience physical or sexual violence in their lifetime.
source: WHO Fact Sheet on Violence Against Women, 2026

stat: On average, a woman or girl is killed by an intimate partner or family member every 10 minutes.
source: UNODC / UN Women, Femicides in 2024: Global Estimates, 2025

stat: Over 80% of women globally report experiencing public street harassment, forcing many to restrict their movement and career opportunities.
Less than 40% of women who experience gender-based violence ever report it to authorities, often due to fear, financial dependency, or social stigma.
source: WHO Fact Sheet on Violence Against Women, 2026

stat: Over 75% of women worldwide (at least 2 billion people) have experienced sexual harassment in the workplace, with perpetrators disproportionately targeting lower-wage and junior employees.
Workplace sexual harassment and violence cost the global economy an estimated 1–3.5% of GDP each year, through medical costs, lost productivity, and premature retirement.
